name: Animal Bites
overview: Bites from livestock, dogs, or wild animals can cause infection and may carry rabies. Clean immediately.

steps.title: Stop the bleeding
steps.detail: Apply pressure with a clean cloth if bleeding.

steps.title: Wash the wound
steps.detail: Rinse thoroughly with soap and water for several minutes.

steps.title: Identify the animal
steps.detail: Note the type of animal and whether it can be observed for rabies. Report to local health department if unknown or wild animal.

when_to_seek_help: See a doctor for any bite that breaks the skin. Go to ER if: deep puncture, face or hand bite, unknown animal, or animal acting strangely. Rabies vaccination may be required.
prevention_tips: Approach animals calmly; avoid sudden movements.
Stay out of pens when animals are stressed or feeding.
Vaccinate dogs and livestock for rabies as recommended.
